name: X
container: max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
code_inline: background: #f7f9f9; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'SF Mono', Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px; color: #d34a26; border: 1px solid #dfe1e2;
code_block: background: #1e1e1e; border-radius: 12px; margin: 14px 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #2f3336;
code_block_header: display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 14px; background: #2d2d2d; border-bottom: 1px solid #3d3d3d;
code_block_dots: width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; margin-right: 6px;
code_block_content: padding: 14px; font-family: 'SF Mono', Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: #e1e8ed; display: block;
blockquote: border-left: 3px solid #1d9bf0; margin: 12px 0; padding: 8px 14px; background: #f7f9f9; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
ol: padding-left: 0; list-style-type: none; margin: 10px 0; counter-reset: ol-counter;
li: margin: 8px 0; line-height: 1.6; position: relative; padding-left: 22px; font-size: 16px;
img: max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; margin: 12px auto; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #dfe1e2;
